title: Pilibhit
desc: Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

title: Shiva
desc: A narrative following a young boy from the Potraj community, who confronts his stepfather, urging him to conform to tradition rather than pursue his aspiration of education and a brighter future. It underscores Shiva's resilience and support system as he strives to fulfill his dreams against all odds.

title: Passbook
desc: Set in the 90's when ATM and instant money transfer were still many years far away. In order to withdraw money people had to rely on a lengthy process of MT or Money Transfer which contained a bank to bank secret code.

title: Scooter
desc: Aniket an entrepreneur is in his hometown, coming after a very long time. Trying to sell his father's home. After spending few hours in that house he goes back into his childhood memories. Aniket as a young boy was very stubborn. This time he was stuck up on a car. Like his many friends, he also wanted to have a car for his family, instead, his father buys a Scooter. He feels very humiliated and refuses to go by it. The story portrays a basic 90s FatherSon relationship

title: Live A Little Part 2
desc: After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

title: Prison
desc: Mini undergoes an assault, and shortly thereafter, her tormentors meet a grim fate. Stricken with fear and disbelief over these uncanny coincidences, Mini questions the source of these events. Could it be her confidante Bini, or something else entirely?

title: Pintu
desc: In a single day, young Pintu skips school, dreams of a better life inspired by a wealthy boy's shoes, and confronts the harsh realities of his underprivileged world, revealing his family's struggles and his own fragile hopes for the future.

title: Salwate
desc: The tale of a mother and son trapped in a challenging home situation and how a straightforward life tip helped them escape their predicament.

title: Makdee
desc: This is the story of a woman whose captivating beauty lures men into her world, much like a spider weaving an irresistible web

title: Panch Din
desc: A Married couple meets in a cafe to take divorce but coincidentally their common friend meets them and reminds them of something which might make a shift to their minds.

title: Ransom Handsome
desc: Ayan and Kabir are small time criminals involved in the kidnapping of a daughter of a dangerous mob boss, Nicole. All they have to do is stick to a kidnapping checklist and check off items as they come to pass. But their novice actions force them to interact with Nicole. Her innocent interactions result in a significantly jacked up ransom amount. Nicole manipulates the situation. Ayan and Kabir struggle to survive as Nicole starts executing her master plan to leave no witnesses behind

title: Party Bhaiya Viral Hai
desc: A satirical comedy on social media, Party Bhaiya follows a young man from a small village who becomes infatuated with a social media influencer through her videos. Drawn by his growing attraction, he tracks down her location to express his feelings in person. However, this encounter delivers a jarring reality check, revealing the stark differences between her online persona and real life. But in the unpredictable world of social media, surprises await, and Party Bhaiya, his online alias, learns that appearances can be deceiving.

title: Chumbak
desc: "Chumbak" follows Aryan and Mitisha, once inseparable lovers, who reunite after years. The old flame reignites, but life has diverged their paths. Caught between duty and desire, they must navigate tough choices, testing their love against the changed tides of circumstance. A poignant tale of love's resilience in the face of reality.
